scope: Default-off codec-owned freeze of the complete original DXF identity census before the callback, plus exact authentication of the adapter-retained AC1018 callback copy after successful read. No identity uniqueness, namespace, owner, graph, output or native semantic claim.

delivery.authority: The codec privately freezes the census before its callback; exact live-publication access supplies an opaque owner-and-pointer-bound ticket. A completed read compares all source, section, record, candidate and physical span fields against the freeze. The codec does not expose its frozen source.
delivery.lifecycle: Ticket issuance is unavailable outside the live callback; same-bytes rereads, different readers, forged owners, reentrant operations, partial reads and exceptions cannot authenticate an old ticket. Each admitted read invalidates the previous ticket. Dropped, copied, altered, duplicate or source-quota-failed adapter delivery leaves the legacy observation unqualified.
delivery.bounds: The freeze precharges section/record/candidate counts, sizing scans, retained payload, ticket and copy/comparison work; allocation or quota failure is sticky for the evidence and does not by itself fail ordinary import.

adversarial_alias.source: Locally authored ASCII and binary examples include a 17-digit leading-zero identity alias numerically equal to an existing handle. The parser observes its physical outer candidate but self-registration marks that candidate Invalid; this is not claimed as an admitted typed duplicate.
adversarial_alias.check: Reclassifying that physical candidate as opaque before forwarding the callback makes the adapter reject the observation; an unchanged fresh-destination retry succeeds.

validation.controls: ASCII/binary: two selected profiles, 136 scalar/span/vector mutation checks, 20 exact/one-under codec quota checks, ten injected freeze-allocation failures, no-handler, dropped callback, forged/cross-reader ticket, partial read, thrown callback, reentrant read and corrected retries; 12 adapter delivery-integrity checks include the hidden long alias.

realSource.result: PASS; default observation remains off, opted-in eight selected observations retained, no namespace/owner/output authority. Source native authoring and semantics are not certified.

limits: Default consumers do not opt into this ledger. The public dxfRW class and adapter data layouts change; dependent binaries require rebuilding. No DRW_Interface virtual was added.

Authenticated delivery does not establish selected-handle uniqueness, valid target types, owner roles, original compound closure, output equivalence or native semantics. The 17-digit alias remains an explicit future uniqueness case.
Per-call quota limits are logical bounds rather than allocator RSS measurements. Full-suite, native-platform and ABI qualifications remain open.
No external or generated drawing fixtures were committed.
